text: Agentic AI systems use autonomous agents that plan multi-step work, call tools, observe results, and revise their plan. Unlike a single prompt, an agent loop keeps state, so failures can trigger retries or a different tool instead of silently producing a wrong answer.
title: Agentic AI: agents that plan and act

text: LangGraph models agent workflows as a state graph: nodes are agents or tools, edges are transitions, and conditional edges route on the current state. A critic node can send work back for revision, and a loop limit guarantees termination. This makes multi-agent behaviour explicit and testable instead of hidden inside one long prompt.
title: LangGraph: state graphs for multi-agent systems

text: Retrieval-augmented generation grounds an AI answer in retrieved documents instead of relying only on model memory. A query is embedded or keyword-matched against a corpus, the top documents are passed as context, and the answer should cite them. Limits include retrieval misses, stale documents, and context-window pressure when too many documents are returned.
title: RAG: retrieval-augmented generation

text: OpenCV is an open-source computer vision library used for object detection, face recognition, tracking, and image processing. Real-time detection typically combines a pre-trained detector with frame-by-frame tracking, and accuracy depends heavily on lighting, camera angle, and training data quality.
title: OpenCV: real-time computer vision

text: A human approval gate holds high-risk AI actions in a pending state until a person reviews them. This is the standard safeguard for sending messages, spending money, or publishing content: the agent proposes, the human approves, and only then does the action execute. Without this gate, agent errors become real-world errors.
title: Human-in-the-loop approval for AI actions

text: n8n is a workflow automation tool where nodes represent triggers, actions, and AI steps connected into a pipeline. A webhook inbox can feed a classifier, a router, and a human approval gate, so routine work is automated while sensitive outputs stay reviewed.
title: n8n workflow automation

text: SEO-friendly content keeps titles under 60 characters, meta descriptions under 155 characters, and slugs short and keyword-rich. Search ranking also depends on genuinely answering the query, not just matching keywords, so briefs should cover the question's angles rather than repeating one phrase.
title: SEO content: titles, meta descriptions and slugs

text: Good agent evaluation checks three things: coverage of the original question, citations back to real sources, and guaranteed termination. A system that loops forever, invents sources, or answers only one angle of a multi-part question fails even if its prose reads well.
title: Evaluating AI agents: coverage, citations and termination
